model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accumulation correlation coefficient (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number for various methods. The x-axis, labeled “Co-occurrence Number,” is a linear scale ranging from 1.0 to 10000, with tick intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%)”, is a linear scale ranging from 30 to 68, with tick intervals of 2. The plot contains five lines: a black line with circular markers, representing “Base,” which begins at approximately 35% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ends at approximately 62% at co-occurrence number 10000; a light purple line with diamond markers, representing “MEND,” which begins at approximately 42% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ends at approximately 57% at co-occurrence number 10000; a cyan line with triangular markers, representing “FT,” which begins at approximately 46% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ends at approximately 65% at co-occurrence number 10000; a scarlet line with triangular markers, representing “IKE,” which begins at approximately 40% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ends at approximately 48% at co-occurrence number 10000; and a forest green line with square markers, representing “ROME,” which begins at approximately 38% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ends at approximately 54% at co-occurrence number 10000.
